summary: qds attributes LTS wording to the queried release only: in multi-release articles the LTS statement must share a sentence with a mention of the queried release.
reason: Greptile P1 on PR #1808: an article saying '9.8 is the LTS release' while merely mentioning 9.10 marked 9.10 as LTS. Sentence bounds treat digit.digit periods as version dots, not sentence ends.
validated_outcome: TestDetectLTSForVersion covers both-release, single-release, and far-mention cases (the misattribution case failed before the fix); full suite and live gate repassed.
